_doc: Registry of the physical NUCLEO-H753ZI boards. stlink_sn = USB serial of the on-board STLINK-V3E (selects the probe); mcu_uid = STM32 96-bit unique ID at 0x1FF1E800 as three 32-bit words (checked over SWD before any flash). COM port numbers are NOT stable and are resolved at run time from stlink_sn. Relevé le 2026-09-25 avec STM32_Programmer_CLI 2.22.0.

A.led_signature: LD1 green: 1 Hz (one 120 ms flash per second)

B.led_signature: LD1 green: 2 Hz (one 120 ms flash every 500 ms)
